title: Improving a decision algorithm on synthetic applicants
description: Four explorations, each with one explorer on its own angle, objective and constraints. The product record is a starter product idea (workspaces/coding-build/templates/product-ideas.seed.json); the algorithm to improve is a small baseline from this repository (benchmarks/fixtures/algorithms/), which Mynt puts into a scratch repository inside the explorer's sandbox. The applicants are synthetic, made by Mynt's generator (src/explore-data.ts), which models them as credit applicants whatever the product's line; nobody real is in them. A task passes on Mynt's own scoring of the holdout only: the commit the explorer pushed is eligible (every constraint holds) and ranks above the baseline, which means a higher objective when the baseline is eligible too. An unchanged copy of the baseline never passes.

product.name: 6-Month No-Penalty CD
product.description: A 6-month certificate of deposit that can be closed early without an early withdrawal penalty after the first week.
key_features: Fixed rate for a 6-month term, set by the firm at opening
Close it and take the whole balance any time after the first 7 days, with no early withdrawal penalty
Opening minimum and maximum set in the firm's terms
Reminder before maturity with the choice to renew or move the money out

algorithm.description: Decides which applicants are approved, and for how much.

product.name: Goal-Locked Money Market Sub-Accounts
product.description: A money market account split into named sub-accounts, each locked to a goal date the holder chooses.
key_features: Up to ten named sub-accounts under one money market account
Each sub-account has a goal amount and a goal date the holder sets
Taking money out of a sub-account before its date needs a waiting period the holder chose at opening
One statement shows every sub-account's balance

algorithm.description: Sets the annual rate each approved applicant pays.

product.name: 24-Month CD with One Rate Reset
product.description: A 24-month certificate of deposit with one request during the term to move to the rate the firm then offers for new CDs of the same term.
key_features: One reset request allowed during the term, to the rate the firm offers that day for new 24-month CDs
The rate after a reset may be higher or lower than the opening rate, and applies for the rest of the term
Early withdrawal penalty as stated in the firm's terms

algorithm.description: Decides which applicants are accepted at all.

product.name: TIPS Ladder Bundle
product.description: One purchase of Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities with staggered maturities, one rung maturing each year over a span the holder picks.
key_features: One rung maturing each year over a span of 3 to 10 years the holder picks
Every rung's maturity date and interest payment dates shown before purchase
Principal adjusted for changes in the Consumer Price Index as the securities' terms state
Each rung's cash moves to a linked account at maturity

algorithm.description: Sets the limit each approved applicant is given.
